reviewed_version_note: One build (sha above) was reviewed in full. The suite file was not edited; its sha was taken before and after the review and did not change (9c1480395d25…3c13 both times). The spec sha matched the brief.

roles.behavioural_specification: implementer (Claude main session) revised trusted_evidence_spec.md for 005-X: 고르는 질문의 코드별 부분 (choice_part, contract v18, parts joined in question order), spec 4; 고르는 질문 부분의 값 검사 (value_retry, withhold of a value still swapped), spec 5
roles.acceptance_construction: a separate agent that read only trusted_evidence_spec.md and the 005-W suite (for format), per the suite's own about text
roles.expected_result_review: a further separate agent that read only trusted_evidence_spec.md (005-X), the 005-X suite and the 005-W review (for format). No .py file in the repository, runs/, benchmarks/, notebooks, tests, the author's scratch folder (author_x) or any other scratch folder or suite was opened and no repository code was run. The suite was split (split.py) into inputs.json and a sealed file (rationale, expected); per-case intake facts (code, procedure, location, region, as_of, personal, reply language) were read by hand and admission, pre_inference, uncovered_items, split/choice parts, statuses, must_cite and end_to_end were derived from the inputs by derive.py (derivation_blind.json) before the sealed file was opened; compare.py then compared. focus.py recomputed choice, conflict and first-person checks; harness.py with bank_choice.py, bank_pol.py, bank_val.py tested the patterns and emulates the spec-5 (005-X) value check for choice parts.

independence_limit: All roles are instances of the same model family in one session. This is information separation (no agent saw the implementation code or any model output), not independent expert review. The 'rule' and 'category' labels (e.g. 'choice_vi_reentry_processing_shorter_right_code_second', 'choice_near_miss_…', 'conflict_template_…', 'partial_trap_…') and the suite's 'about' text were visible during derivation and may have primed it; the choice, split and conflict sets were nonetheless recomputed mechanically from the spec rules, and the item table was applied by regular expressions transcribed from spec 4.
review_result: Blind derivation agreed with the suite in 81/81 cases on every spec-derived field (admission ids and reasons, pre_inference, uncovered_items, model_statuses incl. parts, expected_language, must_cite, end_to_end, expected_polarity); no disagreement. Choice parts (spec 4, 005-X) fall on exactly 02 [K-3-1,K-3-2], 22 [K-3-2,K-3-4], 33 [K-3-1,K-3-3], 45 [K-3-2,K-3-4], 62 [K-3-1,K-3-3], 70 [K-3-2,K-3-4], in question order; near-misses 18 (parent/child), 58 (L-6 never named), 60 (no choosing word) and 81 (sub-code split takes precedence; each part names one code) get none. Every choice code except in 70 has its own sentence; no question-quoted value can trip the value check (22 quotes only a date, 70 has no comparable sentence). Number-only conflict pairs fall on exactly 28, 29, 30, 44, 56, 59, 67. No question reads as personal through a status-code letter (K/L). The 323-answer bank found 52 misjudgements on the suite (3 correct failing, 49 wrong passing) and 4 after the proposed 35 edits in 23 cases (0 correct failing; 1 choice conclusion phrased with both codes in one sentence, 1 'sister also pays' claim in 36, the 'ảnh hưởng' substring in 69, one plain value swap in non-choice 60), plus 3 swapped-value answers that only the spec-5 value check catches (known limit).

The 60 swap ('K-3-2는 40일, K-3-3은 15일') is not a choice question, so neither the value check nor a pattern sees it.
Choice cases require both codes and both values in the joined first answer; consistent with spec 4 (005-X): every part names its code and the parts are joined in question order.

A05X-36: 'Lệ phí là 44.000 won cho bạn và em gái bạn mỗi người' (sister also pays) passes; an unsupported claim about a third person is not a spec-5 check and no narrow pattern is proposed.

A05X-62 group 3 '7일/7day/bảyngày' are substrings of 17/27-day forms; any such wrong value is unsupported by the 62 evidence and withheld by the guard.

implementer_changes_after_review: Suite: all 35 proposed edits in 23 cases applied unchanged (plain-word conclusion patterns in the five own-value choice cases and the shared-sentence case 70; the reversed-scope pattern in 58; the cap and permit fixes in 01, 03, 37, 38 and 39; role patterns in 14, 25 and 78; conflict-resolution fixes in 28, 29, 30, 44, 56, 59 and 67; mention alternatives in 37 and 41). Each appended pattern's why starts with '[005-X review]'. No evidence, question, registry record or expected value changed.

Checked before applying: the author's correct sample answers, the joined per-part answers of every split case and the value-first variants fire no pattern and meet every mention group, and every wrong sample is still caught, on both the reviewed and the edited build; the conflict cases' patterns fire on none of 62 conflict answers the real model gave in earlier runs, before or after the edits. The deterministic pipeline with the author's correct answers matches all 81 cases on both builds (pre-inference exact, raw pass, end-to-end correct, model calls equal to the expected parts).

Spec order: the author read the 005-X spec before one sentence was added to section 5 (a value the question itself quotes counts as swapped only when the part states none of its own code's values). The author raised that case; the sentence was added before the review, and the reviewer read the final spec (607b1cef…). The suite avoids question-quoted values in the own-value choice cases (only 70 quotes one, where the value check does not apply), so the change touches no expected value.

Known limit kept: a value swap between choice codes in a joined answer is caught by the pipeline's value check (spec 5), not by the suite's patterns; the author's five one-way swapped samples each trigger the value retry, and a part still swapped after the retry withholds the joined answer.
